jane_cust: Hey team — since ~10:28 UTC i'm seeing steady 502s from the hosted inference endpoint /v1/generate. Happens across multiple API keys for our org. SDK shows repeated retries and our traffic spiked; worried about billing impact. Sample request id in response header: req_0a1b2c3d.

maya_support: Hey @jane_cust — sorry about that. Can you paste the full response body / headers you got? Is it affecting streaming and non-streaming requests?

jane_cust: Non-streaming first. Response header: 
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2032 10:28:14 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d
X-Edge-Proxy: edge-23
```
Body: `{ "error": "upstream connect error or disconnect" }`

kevin_sre: thanks. Can you share the sdk client + retry config? Also approx qps and payload sizes.

jane_cust: Using official node SDK v2.3.0 with defaults. Our workload is agg 25 RPS with spikes to ~120 for short bursts. Typical payloads are 1-2KB prompt, max tokens 512. We saw 502s only during bursts.

sre-bot: [incident-detection] Spike in 502s detected for hosted inference in eu-west-1 starting 2032-01-12T10:27Z. Routing layer shows increased 5xx from edge-23 and proxy-11.

maya_support: pinging infra @kevin_sre @tim_infra to triage routing/backpressure. In parallel, recommend client-side backoff + max attempts so you don't loop. Example: set retries: 3, backoffFactor: 2, jitter: true.

kevin_sre: seeing connection reset counts rising on proxy-11 and queued connections on envoy upstream clusters. Early hypothesis: keepalive exhaustion + a recent config change to idle timeouts on our edge that decreased pooled connections. Observed error pattern matches upstream connect/disconnect.

tim_infra: Confirmed — we pushed a change at 09:50 UTC yesterday that reduced idle_keepalive to 30s as part of a config roll to free sockets. That likely reduced effective connection reuse under bursty clients. Rolling this back now.

kevin_sre: Reproduction steps we used:
1) run wrk2 generating 120 RPS with 200ms think time against /v1/generate with 1.5KB prompt.
2) observe 502s at ~30–60s when pooled connections drop and new connection ramp causes upstream resets.

Example reproduction command:
```
w rk2 -t4 -c100 -d60s -R120 --latency --timeout 60000 \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  --script ./gen_prompt.lua http://edge-host/v1/generate
```

maya_support: Thanks — can you provide a short mitigation for the customer while infra rolls back? (we want to reduce their error surface during rollback)

kevin_sre: Short-term mitigations for customers:
- Add exponential backoff with capped jitter and max attempts 3; prefer 429/502/503-aware backoff.
- Reduce concurrency per client process (e.g., use a local token bucket).
- Enable HTTP keep-alive reuse explicitly in SDK (node: Agent keepAlive: true) so sockets get reused instead of new TLS handshakes.

Code snippet for Node SDK:
```
const https = require('https');
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 16 });
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, agent });
// Retry wrapper (pseudo)
async function callWithRetries(fn) {
  let attempts = 0;
  while (attempts < 3) {
    try { return await fn(); } catch (e) {
      attempts++;
      if (attempts >= 3) throw e;
      await sleep(Math.pow(2, attempts) * 200 + jitter());
    }
  }
}
```

jane_cust: Appreciate the guidance, we'll patch retries/keepalive quickly. Can you confirm if we'll get credits for the extra requests triggered by retries?

billing-bot: @maya_support billing-alert: flagged a sudden usage delta for jane_cust org (org_987). Please open a billing review after remediation.

maya_support: Noted @billing-bot — i'll open a ticket.

tim_infra: rollback completed at 10:32:40 UTC — idle_keepalive restored to 120s. I'm seeing recovered connection pools and 502 rate dropping in the next minute.

sre-bot: [incident-update] edge-23 502 rate decreased to baseline within 90s after rollback.

kevin_sre: We'll follow up with a permanent fix: add adaptive keepalive and add socket pool headroom for bursty clients. We'll also add a small guard in the edge to return 429 when connection pools are saturated instead of proxying and producing 502s.

maya_support: Update for @jane_cust — infra rolled back the edge timeout at 10:32:40 UTC which restored connection reuse and significantly reduced 502s. Please keep your temporary retry cap in place for the next few hours while we monitor. We will also open a billing review for the retry-triggered usage.

jane_cust: Thanks. We'll implement the Agent change and retry wrapper. Can you share the incident/comms id when available so our ops team can track?

maya_support: sure — creating internal incident: INC-2032-0019. I'll post the postmortem link here once it's ready. :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: post-check: observed one anomalous customer that hit sustained very high RPS without keepalive which exacerbated pool exhaustion — reaching out to that customer separately to advise best practices.

billing-bot: Billing review ticket opened: BILL-8721 for org_987 (potential credit). Assigned to billing-ops.

jane_cust: Closing loop on our side — we patched the SDK agent and retries, error rate dropped to minimal. Thank you all for the quick turnaround.

maya_support: closing thread for now — will update with postmortem. If you see anything else ping me. :white_check_mark:
